nom: ROSEN Super Smoothie Cleanser for Preventing Dark Spots and Minor Breakouts

avis.titre: Used to be good now it sucks
avis.texte: Used to be THE BEST facewash. Now since theyve changed the packaging eveything about this cleanser has changed. The consistency is watery the color is different and so are the results. This cleanser used to clear my breakouts overnight and now its whats causing them. Wish they would go back to the old formula.
This is a reformulation from the old bottle. The graininess used to dissolve with water. It no longer does! This is not bad, but it was so much better with the old formula.

avis.titre: Great Product that works on skin gently but stinks
avis.texte: I really like this cleanser as i have a lot of dark spots and hyperpigmentation from post acne marks. This product feels gentle and non stripping on my combo skin my only con is that it kinda smells bad but shows that they dont use any fragrance in their products which is bad for skin… You get used to the smell though!
Couldnt stand the smell near my face , i tried to give it another try bevause of how expensive the bottle is but i just cant do it. I eish i could return it snd get my money back

I received a 4.3 oz bottle of this mud-colored cleanser as a free gift when I ordered other beauty products from Ulta. I used 1/4 of the cleanser, before I just couldn't stand smelling the scent near my face anymore, so I threw it the rest of the bottle in the trash! The smell was similar to when new asphalt or tar us being poured onto the roads.

I don't even write reviews but Rosen deserves all their flowers!! Ive been fighting with acne and hyperpigmentation for the last 5 years and NOTHING worked. I started using this facewash in the pm and the honey+kojic acid one in the am and my face was instantly 1000x better. My dark marks have almost faded completely and my acne is pretty much non existent after onlh about 2 weeks of usage. I will say the smell takes some getting used to but it's so worth it. Dont walk, run!!!
I love the way this product made my skin feel and it was very gentle! Worked well for me
Very smooth cleanser for every skin type Its good for dark spots and acne Leaves a Nice glow on your face
When I tell u im obsessed…this cleanser feels amazing on my skin (I have sensitive skin) it delicately exfoliates and leaves skin refreshed and clean. Its totally a must have.

avis.titre: Would love to purchase this product again
avis.texte: This product is really amazing and it's soo good for breakouts specifically the person who has acne problems must use this product
I like how this product reduce my back scars from hives and food allergies and it smells nice

This is the absolute best cleanser. First of all, the ingredients are clean and non-toxic. Second, this cleared my breakout like no other product could do. Will never stop buying this! This is the only product i got as a sample in a "free gift" a year ago that I actually ended up purchasing. Amazing product.

avis.titre: I have bad skin and woww
avis.texte: I'm not gonna hold you—I have the acne bumps, scars, reoccuring acne, and it's not fun. It's been a problem for years so I kinda lost hope, But I got a giftcard for Xmas so I thought why not try this? I use this daily and it honestly has been effective for me. I noticed a slight difference so far I'm only 1/3 of the way through my first bottle. It doesn't dry you skin out and the smell is pretty mild. I definitely would use this if you have problematic skin like me. I wear a lot of makeup so I break out. I will say that is has faded my scars and the bumps on my cheeks aren't as harsh. Yay!! Give it a try and see what it does for you.

I used to get minor breakouts all over my forehead and my chin. This has greatly reduced my breakouts and has made my skin so much clearer and much more glowy. I get compliments frequently on how great my skin looks all because of this product.

So I have purchased and gone through two bottles of this cleanser. I am giving it 3 stars but I would probably buy it again for my skin, the product did not do at all what it claims. But it is a nice cleanser which is why I am giving it 3 stars it is slightly exfoliating and definitely feels my skin feeling clean but not squeaky People are overreacting about the smell. it isn't bad it just doesn't smell like vanilla or candy. it smells like it is made with real ingredients sort of similar to something from Lush. There aren't a lot of cleansers out there I would re-buy but this one is pretty good for what it is. if you actually need it to clear breakouts or balance skin and darkness... in my experience it didn't do that

I love how clean my face feels after use. Its thick and gives a good lather. If you're used to the smell of black soap, then you're good. IYKYK. I pair it with the Moonlight Moisturizer for a clean glow. Perfect match!

I tried this face wash this morning. I received it as a sample. I almost vomited. I never in my life ever smelled anything so vile. I couldn't get it off my face fast enough I don't care what kind of results you get the smell is just so offputting I can't use it.

This skincare line from Rosen has made me so glowy and smooth! I use the cleanser, toner, vitamin c serum, and moisturizer and my skin has literally transformed. And I don't even use the whole system as often as I should and it has still garnered results! My pores are smaller, my skin so so smooth and plump and I no longer get the sporadic breakouts I used to. And I get soooo many compliments on my skin when I'm out and about! I am a lifelong user. My skincare search is over. Rosen over everything😍😍😍

avis.titre: I would Buy this product again!
avis.texte: I love this product because It leaves my skin soft and smooth, I'm from Texas so I can easily get it online and it doesn't take as long. I have purchased several as gifts for loved ones and family and everyone has told me they were delighted with the product!

I was so excited when I thought I was receiving this as a gift with purchase for another product I was buying. I had been looking at this and was going to purchase it anyway. It sounds like it would be a holy Grail product and everything I had been looking for in a face wash. as soon as I got it, I was so excited to use it that night. But the minute I opened it and put it near my face I was horrified. Smells don't usually get to me. Can take them or leave them. Even apple cider or some of the other more smelling products most people dislike don't usually bother me. This however? Literally I could not stand to put it near my face. I did still use it. Thinking maybe it would be worth it. I mean, why would a company put out a product that smelled that rancid if it wasn't worth it? So I tried it. And I traded a few more times. This product is not worth it and the smell is absolutely horrific. And it doesn't wash away. I could smell it forever afterwards. Even after washing my face and hands with a different cleanser. Absolutely disgusting. I am shocked at all the positive reviews and it makes me wonder if the sample I received had actually gone bad and if that is not, supposed to smell? I am curious to know but just a heads up … the product I received was absolutely disgusting. And it sounds like there's quite a few others that have the same issue.

This product is so easy to use and like other exfoliating products this one does not I repeat it does not wreck your skin the little beads are so soothing and dont damage, your skin barrier has helped my dark spots a lot and my breakouts
Smells disgusting and honestly didnt work for me. So using this product was short lived.
I absolutely love this product. I love how it lathers well and helps with my acne and hyperpigmentation. I recommend this product to anyone that is dealing with hyperpigmentation or acne.
I loved this cleanser! It helps keep my skin clear and it feels so nice in my skin!
Very well priced worked great for my skin it got rid of dark spots and moisturized my skin
LOVE THE WAY IT BRIGHTENS MY SKIN AND Leaves it feeling clean!!!
I LOVE this product. It has significantly helped get rid of my dark spots and prevent acne.

This product is a very useful and beneficial . It doesn't only leave your skin deep cleanse, remove dirt and impurities but also help prevent breakout and dark spots. It is easy to apply and amazing ingredients that are beneficial to skin.

I am obsessed with this cleanser. This brand is by a Black Woman and it's so refreshing that we now have products geared towards specific skincare issues POC have in stores. I am ALWAYSSSSS looking for something for hyperpigmentation. I have cleared so much of my old hyperpigmentation up; but it's an ongoing thing. I'll always battle with it because that's just how my skin is. If I have any little bump on my face it will most likely leave a scar. So I'm always looking for things to include in my skincare routine that will handle that. My skin has really been through it the last few months due to alot of things I've been personally going through. I needed something that would REALLY help my skin out and this brand DEFINITELY did that. I'm honestly floored with how much I love everything. The Super Smoothie cleanser is a standout favorite. I have many face washes that I love but this one is truly at the top for me. It's a 'non stripping cleanser for dark spots and textured skin' I have never had a cleanser that made my skins texture even out so much after just one wash. It also isn't too drying for my normal to dry skin. It also brightened my skin so much after one wash. I'm not joking when I say some of my hyperpigmentation cleared up so fast with this cleanser I was shook. This stuff is magic, straight up. I really love it.

avis.titre: Not sure how I feel about this
avis.texte: Got this randomly one day because their earth or green cleanser interested me but they didnt have it so I saw this one randomly and got it. First off I will say I've never been one to complain about smells with products whereas I feel some people just always like to complain when I dont think a product smells bad at all….THIS ONE on the other hand smells so freaking bad. It smells like rancid and expired fruit in a bottle. Its horrifying. Everytime I use this, I hold my breath and that still isnt good enough. I'm not sure if this cleanser does anythinh for me. After washing, it almost leaves your face with a dry film over it. The bottle is also not even all the way filled upon purchasing and I looked at every bottle on the shelf. I also find this to be expensive for how little you get. 3 stars just because I havent noticed anything bad besides the smell and nothing amazing about this.
This product works really well. Helps to nurture my skin brighten my skin and helps fade dark spots quickly

From breaking out to dark spots! This face wash has definitely changed my everyday skincare! In a two week time frame, my face have cleared up drastically. I would recommend this face wash to anyone trying to fight ance!
I have been using Rosen for years now and I love this facial cleanser. It is gentle on my skin but also makes it feel so soft and nice! I recommend to anyone who will listen!

My skin has been terrible since i got off hormonal birth control, I impulse bought a few products from this company. After 3 days of use, my skin looks and feels and smells amazing. I'm older and I've tried a lot of products, it surprising how simple and effect this stuff is. The price is excellant as well. Will purchase again and again. I bought cleanser, serum, and moon moisturizer. All are great so far!
This cleanser is gentle at exfoliating and effective at decreasing dark spots. It does not irritate my sensitive skin. I use it on my face, back and chest.

avis.titre: Soothing and reliable daily face wash
avis.texte: I've been using super smoothie cleanser for years. It keeps my face clear with its light exfoliation and nourishing ingredients. When I use it consistently I never need to worry about breakouts, even small ones! With Rosen products, my skin is always brighter, too. Don't hesitate--Rosen products are incredibly high quality and worth every penny.

This product has been the GOAT in my skincare routine. It has truly help elevate acne and has become an absolute staple in my skincare routine. Anytime someone ask me about my skin I say this cleanser & water, lol!

I have normal to dry skin but have breakouts under the chin. This cleans your face but leaves not odd residue, and also smells oddly like an oatmeal raisin cookie. I suggest it, non irritating and lathers nice. (I'm just a 26 year old I'm not being paid.

I love this face wash. LOVE. It's just the right balance of exfoliant, non-drying, and still makes my skin feel super clean and smooth. And the ingredients are great--love the subtle natural strawberry smell. I have been using this cleanser for a few months now. Thankful to now have a go-to facewash after years of trying different things.

I have been using the Super Smoothie Cleanser for quite some time now and I absolutely love it. I have combination acne prone skin and this cleanser has helped smooth my texture and fade my acne marks. It leaves my skin feeling clean without the tight stripped feeling. The vitamin C brightens my skin and leaves me glowing. This cleanser is a staple in my skincare routine and I wouldn't change it for anything else!

I loveeee and adore this cleanser! The tiny exfoliates are JUST enough for an everyday upkeep, consistency is amazing and hydrating and surprisingly a little goes a long way!! My skin is so happy with it,especially when paired with the tropics toner

avis.titre: The Super Smoothie Cleanser is my fave cleanser from Rosen!
avis.texte: I really love this product. I've been using it for years. I love that it gets sudsy and makes your face feel like it's getting cleaned, while also being a gentle exfoliant because of it's texture.
I have acne prone, sensitive, combination skin and so far I am liking this cleanser. I switch between this and the Earth Cleanser!

My favorite cleanser. I have struggled a bit with finally a clwanswr scrub thats not to harsh on my face and this gets the job done everytime. My absolute favorite cleanswr and I recommend it to everyone who asks about my skincare. 10/10

I love this cleanser for my hormonal breakouts, oily/combo skin. It is my go to cleanser & I have even recommended & purchased ROSEN products for my family as well because the products have been a game changer!

This has been the best for my skin. Very hydrating, silky and I love the smell. I have dry combination skin. Everything is dry but my nose. I typically end my day with oil literally sitting on my nose and the rest of my face having kind of gloss over it. Since I started using this over a year ago it's been a balanced, even glow.
I really love this product, I've refilled it a few times and just using it daily makes my skin feel amazing. My favorite cleanser scrub
My skin lovvvess this product! I'm oily and this is the best cleanser I've had to date! My natural oils don't get stripped & it does great at exfoliating 🥳

I've been using Rosen for about 3–4 years now. My skin has never looked better. I particularly love this cleanser in the winter because it gently exfoliates my skin. My skin always feels really smooth after use.

I saw results within 3-4 weeks.This cleanser is a good fit for my combo skin, and I find that it works best for me at night. I really like how simple the ingredients are and you can actually understand what's in the bottle. The size of the bottle is also generous, so it will last for a long time.I would definitely recommend this cleanser to anyone looking for a product that can help fade dark spots and cleanse the skin without stripping the skin.
This is the only cleanser that does not break me out or cause my eczema to flare! Been using it for years and my dark marks always seems to vanish! Love this and their dark marks line
I enjoy this product a lot it has helped my acne scars and hyperpigmentation and even brake outs!

avis.titre: a product i'll use for life!
avis.texte: I have been loyal to Rosen products for over 2 years now and the brand fully cleared and healed my skin. I use this cleanser in rotation with the Earth cleanser. I like the sudsy, slightly grainy texture of this one. I feel like it really cleans my face well and removes makeup and excess oil without making my skin feel stripped. Some days i even double cleanse and I use this wash first and then the Earth cleanser - I know it sounds excessive but I love it. :)
This product is the holy grail of cleansers that you can utilize year round.

avis.titre: Best Cleanser for acne and dark spots!
avis.texte: This is my favorite cleanser for my skin! I have hormonal acne and dark spots from aging and this product has helped tremendously! I recommend to anyone with those issues.

avis.titre: I absolutely love this face wash
avis.texte: I love this face wash and so does my face. I've been using this since 2020 and it has definitely helped with clearing up my hormonal acne and the scarring and hyperpigmentation I had on my face. I love how all the ingredients are natural. It gives a really good glow. I won't use any other face wash!

avis.titre: Get it you won't regret it!
avis.texte: Rosen product have been a god send for me, I suffered from hyperpigmentation due to acne and I've been using this as well as the tropics moisturizer and toner and let me tell you!!!!!! my results have been absolutely amazing my skin glows and has been so smooth. I absolutely recommend Rosen products if you're thinking twice about purchasing

I'm so upset, I know trying new face products can be risky and it can definitely be expected that a new product might make you 'purge' or irritate your existing acne, but it is very much unexpected to develop new zits almost immediately after use in a place that you NEVER breakout and have never had any skincare issues with. about 1 hour after use i have 4 bumps on my neck which is an area I've never had acne. I'm also noticing new small bumps all over my face. I'm so sad and scared, and worried that I'm about to develop a rash or something :( so upsetting as i have slowly been making progress on my acne over the years. My skin looks terrible right now I'm so devastated. This is after only one use, please stay away its not worth the risk. I will literally be crying myself to sleep tonight.

this makes my skin so clean and glowy. I haven't tried any other cleansers in forever! my skin loves it. the ONLY con is the weird smell but I've tired their other cleanser and the difference is obvious. I can get over the smell because it's so good for my skin.

If you're a hairstylist, youll recognize the smell. It smells like Shades EQ, which is VERY weird to be rubbing on your face especially when the texture and color is also kind of similar. But it does clean really well and leaves skin comfortable and not tight.
I love the product and was glad to see it was available at Ulta. Unfortunately they keep sending me expired products. The cleanser works well for my sensitive skin.

I originally went on the website and got the hyper pigmentation in dark spot set. This included the cleanser the vitamin C, serum, toner, and moisturizer. I separately bought a mask so in total I spent $78 and after using it for 60 days the only changes are that I have had less breakouts but it did not clear of any dark spots or fade any of my hyperpigmentation ￼

i love rosen, always have, even before they started selling in retail stores. however, because they use natural ingredients, they have a short shelf life and ulta does not know this! i bought a cleanser last weekend and it was expired for months. always check the bottom of the bottle for the exp date! the products will still be usable but the consistency and the effectiveness of the product will not be the same.
I love this product. My skin has almost completely quit breaking out and looks glowy and smooth.

This is a holy grail! I use this as a second cleanse every night and it makes my skin so smooth and glowing. The scent is not a big deal at all, barely noticeable for me. It's slightly exfoliating and lasts me a long time.
Best cleanser!! I have been using this cleanser for 3 years now and so good for dark spots and it leaves your skin glowing. Recommend it!! 100% and affordable
Dries out dead skin and nourishes at the same time better than any cleanser I've used before!
Dries out dead skin and nourishes at the same time better than any cleanser I've used before!
My skin was going through a period of constant break outs. I used this and saw a difference in texture and my breakouts FINALLY stopped

avis.titre: Love this product but wish it was the old formula
avis.texte: This cleanser is the only thing that has worked for my skin to keep the acne from my chin. It isn't heavy or oily and works best for me if I use it twice daily. I will say the new formula I give 4 stars. The previous formula was darker and thicker. It was hard to get out of the bottle a bit, but I feel like it was more exfoliating and cleansing. I have half a bottle of the previous formula that I use when my skin really needs cleansed, once it's gone, I'm going to be really sad.

Yes it has an odd smell but I would rather have that than irritating fragrance added. I used a sample I received of this and in the am I couldn't believe how bright my skin looked after one use. I love the texture of this and it is not at all drying. I've been using now for a week with no irritation to my sensitive and dry 46 year old skin. I will be purchasing the full size and maybe trying some other products from this line.

This was unfortunately just okay for me. I was really looking forward to this product after reading the reviews, and the smell was a bit odd yea but it was easy to adjust quickly enough. It didn't really make a dent in my dark spots or acne after a couple months of use, but it did make my skin brighter/ more glowy when paired with my fav vitamin c serum (Korea wild rose 15%). Since I loved the tropics moisturizer so much I still wanted to support Rosen and ended up getting their Earth Cleanser, which I found was a much greater fit for me. I hope to see it at Ulta soon!

first time using this product it had cleared my skin by the next morning, every area I had been breaking out the night before was noticeably minimized and my skin was smooth and less red and irritated. I'm bad at picking at my acne, even areas I had acne scars from this are becoming unnoticeable. the smell seems to be the only thing I see people rating this product low on and honestly it's very tolerable. normally I won't use a product that smells bad even if it works so I get it, but the smell is not bad at all. I got a sample size of this product but when it runs out I will definitely be buying a full size.

I was hesitant to buy after reading people didn't like the smell. The smell is different, but you get used to it and it's just natural smelling. I've been using it for a couple weeks and my skin has never been clearer. I've also noticed I have a more even tone.

avis.titre: Love it! Smoothie makes smoother skin
avis.texte: I've used this for about two months now and I've gotten so many compliments on my skin. My complexion seems brighter and healthier since switching and my skin feels softer/smoother. It's black-owned and feels like it was made for my melanated skin. Thank you for making this!

I've had acne and texture problems my whole life. Acne treatments weren't enough. I've tried so many different cleansers, toners, creams, etc. But this stuff has made a SERIOUS difference. I don't have to wear foundation anymore, my skin is clear and even! I have a full routine, but this was the main game changer. It doesn't smell good though, kind of stinks. My only complaint, but it still gets 5 stars.

I absolutely LOVE the way this makes my skin feel. It's a very gentle exfoliation that leaves my problem areas softer and smoother. It does have a smell some might find unpleasant but it's easy for me to look past that, given the results!!

People are being dramatic when talking bad about the smell. Sure it's not 5/5 smells amazing but for ALL if the benefits this face cleanser provides it's completely worth it. Rating this product out of 10, I'd give it a 10/10. Rating the smell from 1 being the worst to 5 being the best, I would rate it 4/5. It's seriously not THAT bad. People are just so used to products being over saturated with harmful fragrances.

I've been using Rosen for a while now and my skin has never been better, I could cry. Ive tried so many expensive face products and some drugstore ones, and nothing is as amazing as this, especially especially at this price! Rosen fan for life!
I got a sample of this cleanser and really liked it! I felt that it was making a difference in my skin, but not stripping it at all. I'm excited to pick up the full size!

I received a trial size of this in a goodie bag from ULTA. I never would have sought out this product on my own, and so far I am loving it! It's such a gentle exfoliation and I watched it literally take my mascara right off my eyelashes and eye area. Some people mention a smell but I have sniffed it several times and can't really smell anything. It washes off very clean with no left behind residue. My skin looks healthier and almost a little glow-y, and my pores look better too. My face feels refreshed instead of dry afterwards. I'm 34 with combo skin (oily t-zone but dry cheeks) and this face wash really seems like an overall winner!
it gives me such a nice cleanse without that skin tightening feel one star off because there is a smell but it's nothing compared to the brand faded's stuff
it's a pleasant smell it was awesome I tried other skin care brands but this one was the best I will be buying again!

avis.titre: Works great! Can't get over the smell...
avis.texte: I got this product as a sample sized product and it's worked really well and really quick. However the smell is absolutely unbearable and i have to hold my breathe while I quickly use it because it's so gross. I'd love to keep purchasing it but can't justify the price with the smell...
I got a sample of this and I'm glad I didn't get a full size, it smells so bad I had to hold my breath until it was completely washed off, it smells like burnt plastic but worse.

I liked the texture of this cleanser but couldn't stomach the smell. I used it again hoping I could tolerate the scent, but sadly the smell was too overwhelming. I wonder if it has gone bad (spoiled). I hope this cleanser is reformulated in the future. I'd be willing to try it again.

After a day working outside, this stuff cuts right through all the sweat and dirt and sunscreen. The texture is slightly rough but not gritty if that makes sense. I didn't find the scent to be overwhelming at all. It's not a bad smell, just not outright pleasant.

I really wanted to try this cleaner. I have noticed a difference in my skin since using for about a month now, so I do like it. Feels very clean and moisturized without stripping my skin. I like the light exfoliation in. The smell is god awful. I expected it to be more fruity but to me it's smells like sweet potatoes. I have gotten used to it, but I don't think I will repurchase just because of the smell. Also, small bottle. I don't feel like I really need to use a big amount but after using morning and night consistently I'm already almost out.
I dont like the smell but it really works,I have horrible hormonal acne and this is the first wash that really helped with it

The face wash felt good on my skin. It wasn't so rough like a lot of scrubs are. I liked that it was gentle but it smelled like a wet dog. Maybe I received a spoiled bottle? I had to throw it out unfortunately. The color wasn't very appealing but I could deal with that.

avis.titre: I have tried so many acne products
avis.texte: I have acne scars, large inflamed bumps, small bumps, black heads you name it. I have used cerave for years and my skin always had issues and was never fully healed or getting better. I have only used this cleanser for 1 week and I can already see a difference!! I'm honestly shocked. This cleanser is so gentle, cleans my skin, and has reduced my acne significantly in the past few days. Thank you Rosen!

I really wanted to love this products because it's black, woman owned. I truly couldn't get past the smell. It smells very bad and maybe it's because the products are very natural. Not for me. I'm giving it two stars because the texture and formula felt good while washing my face.
Saw dark spots fading after 3 washes. Also shrank dairy-induced deep acne bumps in 4 washes. Using this with toner & tropics moisturizer, love it! No filler ingredients!!!

avis.titre: So happy ROSEN has come to Ulta
avis.texte: I've been using ROSEN products for about two years now - this is one of the best cleansers out there. Not over-drying, smells wonderful, and has a nice texture to it that helps to remove all the gunk from the day. I try to alternate my cleansers semi-regularly, but I'll always come home to this one.

avis.titre: I wish I smelled it before I bought it
avis.texte: I dont think it did anything for my skin and it has a weird "hair relaxer" smell.
Absolutely love this cleanser, my hormonal acne has gone down and breakout during my period was barley there.
The only product that helps my acne! So happy Ulta is selling this product now.
